error: LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN is not set. Sandbox tokens expire after 7 days; mint a new one with `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` and export it.
exit=1

The smoke test didn't run. `scripts/ledger_smoke.py` stopped right away with exit code 1 because `LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN` isn't set in this environment:

```
error: LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN is not set. Sandbox tokens expire after 7 days; mint a new one with `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` and export it.
```

Nothing was posted to the sandbox.

To get it running, mint a token and run the script again:

```sh
export LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN=$(acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx)
python scripts/ledger_smoke.py
```

I didn't mint the token myself because that creates a credential under your account. I can do it if you want, or you can export an existing token that's still valid and I'll rerun the script.
